_comment: Tripo text-to-3D subject prompts, one per ITEM_CATALOG id. Each subject is composed with _style and _negative by generate.mjs. Subjects are authored from the item's name, slot and flavor line so the mesh reads as that specific item; _style is shared so all 51 belong to one visual family.
_style: game-ready fantasy game item, strong readable silhouette, stylized hand-painted PBR materials, isolated single object floating, centred, no ground plane, no pedestal, no stand, no character, no text
_negative: text, watermark, logo, ground plane, base, pedestal, stand, mannequin, multiple objects, human figure, hands, scene, background
